title: arenaria querioides subsp. racemosa
intro: Arenaria querioides subsp. racemosa, commonly known as rock jasmine, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as digestive issues and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of rock jasmine include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its purported health benefits. The bioactive constituents of rock jasmine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
